title.narrative: Strengthening export capacities of manufacturing SMEs in Kuwait

description.narrative: The objective of this UNIDO project is to strengthen the capacities of the Industrial Exports Development Center (IEDC) to provide support services to exporting companies and to strengthen the export capacities and improve the export competitiveness of Kuwaiti manufacturing companies in the #chemicals, coal, rubber and plastic# sector. The pilot project aims at improving the capacities of Kuwaiti companies to penetrate new and promising markets and at fostering the capacities of the Industrial Exports Development Center (IEDC) # an institution belonging to PAI - to provide support services aimed at increasing industrial exports.
